t: Where wealth and children actually sit
a: ٱلْمَالُ وَٱلْبَنُونَ زِينَةُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَٱلْبَـٰقِيَـٰتُ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ أَمَلًا
p: Al-mālu wa-l-banūna zīnatu-l-ḥayāti-d-dunyā, wa-l-bāqiyātu-ṣ-ṣāliḥātu khayrun ʿinda rabbika thawāban wa khayrun amalā.
m: Wealth and children are [but] adornment of the worldly life. But the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for [one's] hope.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
